relationships.subject: TFDB
relationships.evidence_quote: TFDB inhibited capsaicin-induced TRPV1 receptor currents in acutely isolated dorsal root ganglion (DRG) neurons of rats

relationships.subject: TFDB
relationships.evidence_quote: The level of TRPV1 expressions of DRG neurons was also decreased in TFDB-treated CFA-inflammatory pain rats.

relationships.subject: TFDB
relationships.evidence_quote: TFDB (20 mg/kg) was fully efficacious on complete Freund's adjuvant (CFA)-induced inflammatory thermal hyperalgesia

key_findings: TFDB inhibits capsaicin-induced TRPV1 currents in rat DRG neurons (IC50 16.7 mg/L) and is analgesic in formalin, capsaicin and CFA models.
TFDB also lowers TRPV1 expression in DRG of CFA rats.
